### Justice Left to God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/justice-left-to-god
Passage: 2 Samuel 3:31
Points:
- David strongly condemned Joab's treacherous murder of Abner and pronounced divine retribution upon the guilty commander.
- Despite having the royal authority and duty to execute justice under God's law, David hesitated to confront his fierce nephew.
- David led the nation in heartfelt mourning by fasting, walking behind the bier, weeping at the grave, and singing a lament for Abner.
- The sincerity of David's public grief convinced all the people that he had no involvement in Abner's death.
- David's failure to administer civil justice serves as a reminder to pray for governing authorities to punish evil and reward good.
